title: FLA import: motionEase tween interpolation not applied — ease value silently ignored
description:
When tweens are imported from Flash 8 binary FLA, the motionEase value (0-100 easing strength) is read from the binary but not applied during SWF compilation. The tween interpolator in packages/core/src/engine uses linear interpolation regardless of ease setting.

See packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/tween-interp.test.ts:124 for the documented TODO.

Expected: a tween with ease=100 (ease-in) should map to a non-linear cubic interpolation curve in the compiled SWF (custom easing via DefineShape morph or ActionScript). A tween with ease=-100 (ease-out) should ease out.

Note: SWF has no native ease field — Flash emulates easing by computing intermediate keyframes or via AS2 Tween class. The simplest correct approach for motion tweens is to bake the eased position into intermediate frames or emit the correct PlaceObject2 transforms per-frame using the eased t-value.
